title: Embrace fullness of Life
author: Palavali Vijayalakshmi Pandit
text:
“Life”..;the tricky thief
Indulge in igniting love
Among genders of beings
Seduced by love games
Couples of all races
Deliver their offsprings,
Motherhood play key role,
In fact in true sense the
Children are not our children
They are ..,”Life”longing for itself;
Life`s eternal plan of action
For it`s survival on the Earth,
The poor souls not knowing
The truth are thrown into
An unending agony thriving for
The so called happiness but..
The secret lies in the art of living;
To embrace the fullness of life
With clear mindset to maintain
The balance of our life..!!
